title: invoicer configuration
description: What invoicer needs to know about the countries we invoice.

countries.description: The countries we invoice, by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. An invoice is in its customer's country's currency, and gets its VAT rate unless the invoice sets taxRate.

currency.description: The currency of the country's invoices, as an ISO 4217 code: one that invoicer can print (CURRENCIES in src/types.ts).

vatRate.description: The VAT (or sales tax) an invoice to this country gets when it sets no taxRate, as a fraction: 0.2 is 20 %.
